name: Claude Code
description: Runs Khadim chats through the local Claude Code CLI.
author: Khadim contributors

config.label: Binary path
config.description: Claude Code executable. Install and authenticate Claude Code before using this harness.

config.label: Claude config directory
config.description: Optional CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for an isolated Claude Code account and settings without changing the operating-system home directory.

config.label: Permission mode
config.description: Claude Code permission mode: default, acceptEdits, dontAsk, plan, auto, or bypassPermissions.

config.label: Available tools
config.description: Optional comma-separated restriction on which Claude Code tools are available.

config.label: Pre-approved tools
config.description: Optional comma-separated tools that may run without a permission prompt. This does not restrict tool availability.

config.label: Disallowed tools
config.description: Optional comma-separated Claude Code tool denylist.

config.label: Reasoning effort
config.description: Optional Claude effort level: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

config.label: Trust project settings
config.description: Load project and local Claude settings, including hooks and MCP servers that can execute with your user permissions. Enable only for trusted projects.
